verdict.rationale: Rev AI documents an Asynchronous Speech-to-Text API that accepts submitted transcription jobs, including job parameters like source_config and human transcription jobs, and returns transcripts once processing completes. Webhooks are documented for completion notifications, but the evidence never shows a polling endpoint or a defined set of job states. missing for 10: documented job status endpoint for polling, enumerated job states (e.g., in_progress/transcribed/failed), independent or hands-on corroboration of the polling workflow.
